scope: Metadata correction only: the 2024 Nationalrat polling day (29 September 2024), until now taken from the national election source registry (background_to_verify), is now sourced to the federal government ordinance BGBl. II Nr. 169/2024, § 2. No vote, seat or count changes.

owner_decisions.decision: Owner approval: www.ris.bka.gv.at registered for manual reading of named legal texts, institutional facts only.
Owner brief 'historical parliamentary election backfill' (Austria 2024 election metadata) and answer 'Austria: read RIS notice'.

reuse_right.basis: Federal law gazette text: laws and ordinances are free works under UrhG § 7(1). Only the date and the quoted clause are stored.

normalized_republication.basis: The polling day and a one-sentence quotation of § 2; the 2013–2024 admission is otherwise unchanged.

raw_redistribution.basis: The RIS page is cited by URL; no file is stored; signatories are not recorded.

acquisition_route.basis: Read once by hand in a browser: the RIS search result list (/Ergebnis.wxe) and the document page /Dokumente/BgblAuth/BGBLA_2024_II_169/, both outside the paths RIS disallows. www.bmi.gv.at was not contacted.

source_files_complete.basis: The ordinance has three sections; § 2 fixes the Wahltag, § 3 the reference day (9 July 2024), both recorded.

national_definition_complete.basis: build-nationalrat check unchanged for every year; all 2024 rows other than the election row are byte-identical apart from checksums.

same_election_identity_complete.basis: Same election id el-at-nr-2024-09-29; the date already matched.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: Unchanged; the ordinance cites § 1 Abs. 2 NRWO as its legal basis.

vintage_decisions_complete.basis: The polling day is a legal fact fixed by the ordinance of 28 June 2024 (published that day), distinct from the result decision of 16 October 2024.
